title: Sunday · the walk, as a map
logline: The walk drawn as a map in three tiers: the alley to the seawall, the seawall to the flats, the flats home. Two small figures moving along the line. The Sunday that ends up pinned to the corkboard.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a hand-drawn map tier: the tavern, the alley, the garage, a dotted line to the seawall, two tiny figures on it.

image.prompt: a hand-drawn watercolor map of a small coastal town with a dotted walking line from an alley to a seawall and two tiny figures on it, no words

panels.name: Alley

panels.composition: Tier 2: the map continues: seawall, bait shack, the flats, the line looping.

image.prompt: a hand-drawn watercolor map continuing along a seawall to a bait shack and tidal flats with a dotted line looping and two tiny figures, no words

panels.name: Seawall

panels.composition: Tier 3: the map's end: the flats back to the alley, the line closing, an X at the garage.

image.prompt: a hand-drawn watercolor map with a dotted line returning across tidal flats to an alley and a small X at a garage, no words

panels.name: Home

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving
